title: K2 Space button
description: Square-cornered controls: a flat near-black button (lighter on hover, 0.2s), a 56px square arrow button for sliders, and a quiet grey text link with an arrow that lights up on hover.
notes: renders an <a> when given href, otherwise a <button>
name: k2space-button

props.name: children
props.description: the label (for arrow buttons, give ariaLabel instead)

props.name: href
props.description: a link target; without it the control is a <button>

props.name: variant
props.description: solid: flat filled block · arrow: 56px square slider control · link: grey text with an arrow

props.name: direction
props.description: which way the arrow points (arrow and link variants; solid shows a small right arrow)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: the accessible name, needed for arrow buttons
